prompts.map:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide landscape tactical world map background for Bitforge, an educational dystopian network-resistance game.
Primary request: Recognizable stylized Earth continents in a flat world map, dark oceans, dim occupied city clusters with tiny restrained coral lights. Show North and South America on left, Europe and Africa center, Asia and Australia right. Clear coastlines, restrained detail and broad dark areas suitable for interactive node overlays.
Style/medium: polished pixel-art meets low-poly strategy-game terrain, crisp geometric coastline and subtle terrain facets, premium game artwork.
Composition: landscape 3:2 ratio, full map visible, clean edge-to-edge background, no perspective globe, map comfortably inset from edges.
Color palette: dark navy #10171e and near-black ocean, muted blue-gray and teal land masses, tiny cyan and coral city lights; very subtle lime accents #b6f36b.
Lighting/mood: atmospheric, ominous occupied Earth, legible subdued contrast.
Constraints: No text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no UI panels, no map pins, no node markers, no connection lines, no logos, no watermark.
prompts.robot:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square enemy portrait/card artwork for Bitforge educational dystopian resistance game.
Primary request: An original intimidating but school-appropriate Overseer sentinel robot, angular black armored machine with one single glowing coral optic. Head and broad upper-body silhouette, compelling powerful game antagonist.
Scene/backdrop: dark smoky navy #10171e background, restrained atmospheric haze.
Style/medium: polished pixel-art meets low-poly game art, crisp deliberate geometric armor plates and refined chunky pixel texture, premium indie strategy-game enemy portrait.
Composition/framing: square, centered robot bust, readable silhouette and strong focal point on single eye, shoulders mostly inside frame with comfortable margin above head.
Lighting/mood: ominous but suitable for school audiences; subtle cyan rim light on black armor and coral glow around single eye.
Color palette: navy, charcoal and steel blue, one coral red optic, restrained cyan.
Constraints: no human, no gore, no weapons, no text, no logos, no watermark, no UI borders, no extra eyes.
